display_long_description:
This is not a calm dinner simulator. This is a romantic disaster sandbox.

Step into a VR dating experience where every interaction can turn awkward, chaotic, or completely unhinged. Flirt, provoke, impress, or sabotage the moment. Nothing is scripted, and everything reacts.

# 🎭 Unpredictable Personalities

[media]

Meet dates that don’t behave:

👽 An alien who manipulates gravity

📱 A streamer filming you non-stop

🍔 A messy foodie who throws snacks

🕶️ A suspicious spy with hidden motives

⚡ A chaotic wildcard who fights back


They don’t just talk. They react physically.

# 🌭 Use Items to Make the Date Unforgettable

[media]

Pick the right items… or the wrong ones.

Food, drinks, gadgets, and ridiculous tools can instantly change the mood of the date.

Offer something romantic.

Offer something weird.

Offer something you probably shouldn’t.


Every object can escalate the situation and create totally new reactions.

# 🛠️ Full Physics Sandbox

[media]

Grab objects. Spill drinks. Steal phones. Trigger chaos.

Almost everything around you is interactive and physics-driven.

Romantic dinner… or total meltdown?

Your choice.

# 🎁 Random Surprise Carts

[media]

Open carts to unlock unpredictable tools. You never know what will appear next.

How would you handle the perfect date?
